incidents.additional_logs: AWS GuardDuty: High Severity Alert. Finding: Threat statement followed by unauthorized RDS snapshot deletion attempt from IP 172.16.12.89.
incidents.root_cause: Compromised or rogue privileged insider expressing violent hostility and attempting destructive database wipe.
incidents.investigation_process: Correlated Slack threat statement with AWS CloudTrail API logs showing unauthorized IAM assume-role commands.
incidents.actions_taken: Immediately revoked AWS root/admin credentials, revoked IAM roles, severed SSH sessions to production clusters, disabled physical badge access.
incidents.successful_resolution: Production database safeguarded; backup vaults protected by immutable retention locks; zero data loss.
incidents.analyst_feedback: Detecting hostile sentiment simultaneously with privileged API calls averted multi-million dollar disaster.
